description: This file defines internal data structures, constants, and function prototypes for controlling and querying jemalloc's internal state, including arena statistics, control nodes, and control functions.

classes.name: ctl_node_t
classes.description: Represents a generic control node with a 'named' boolean flag.

classes.name: ctl_named_node_t
classes.description: Represents a named control node with a name, children, and a control function pointer.

classes.name: ctl_indexed_node_t
classes.description: Represents an indexed control node with an index function.

classes.name: ctl_arena_stats_t
classes.description: Holds statistics for a jemalloc arena, including small size class stats and bin stats.

classes.name: ctl_stats_t
classes.description: Contains overall statistics for jemalloc, including memory usage and background thread stats.

classes.name: ctl_arena_t
classes.description: Represents a jemalloc arena with various configuration and statistical fields.

classes.name: ctl_arenas_t
classes.description: Holds a collection of arenas, including active and destroyed ones.

methods.name: ctl_byname
methods.description: Control function to get or set parameters by name.

methods.name: ctl_nametomib
methods.description: Converts a control name to a Management Information Base (MIB) representation.

methods.name: ctl_bymib
methods.description: Control function to get or set parameters using MIB.
